raw_npz_field: state_<period> (N,3,2) original diploid genetic alleles; exact original trace comparison required
raw_receipt_validation: Each original case .json receipt SHA-256 must match original raw .npz bytes, mode/setting/history identity and source manifest consistency.
visitor_exposure_validation: Use EXACT source make_history from frozen sources, or visitor-only stream replay and verify exact visitor IDs/optima/breadths/effectiveness against source on several far/near history controls.
counterfactual: Within each original E (evolving) diploid source population, set only investment alleles of all plants to the original matched F (fixed) branch's mean investment; preserve E matching, assurance and adult census, use same source visitor history and reproductive operator. Separately reset only E assurance to .5 as direct-pollen negative control. DO NOT call raw paired F vs E differences mediated effects.
focal_externality: For every native E plant at snapshot 400, increase its floral investment alleles by 0.002 if admissible, otherwise use a negative 0.002 signed perturbation. Measure change in viable seed of all OTHER mothers and delivered pollen to others with all remaining alleles fixed. Treat within-history focal plants as correlated and report 64 history-level counts.
falsification_policy: If source E evolution produces mean pollen-service loss but net viable maternal seed effect can be positive, do not infer group fitness or long-term persistence loss. Visitor-zero states must give exactly zero nonfocal pollen externality; settings without pollen discount must give zero direct assurance-to-pollen-delivery effect at fixed investment and matching.
scientific_limits: Same ONE Model 3 biological mechanism and previously exposed 64 visitor histories, not independent ecological replication
One of eight nested demographic repeats per history; no 64x8 confirmation
Raw fixed vs evolving states have DIFFERENT genotypes/lineages, so matched arm means are not causal mediation
All investment-clamping is artificial static one-year; not an inherited assurance intervention
No descendants, allele-transmission fitness, extinction or unconditional occupancy estimated
Focal unilateral reproductive externality is not proof of population-level public-goods selection
Pollen-budget 16x saturation feasibility previously failed; near is not well-pollinated natural mainland
